description: This file contains functions related to verifying the URL resolution for the /api/users endpoint in a frontend application. It includes utility functions for constructing expected API URLs, logging, and testing organization-specific URL resolution without making network requests.

methods.name: verifyUsersUrlResolution(organizationIdOverride = null)
methods.description: Constructs and logs the expected URL for the /api/users endpoint with the current or overridden organization ID. It also performs a runtime check for unexpected query parameters and restores the previous organization ID after the check.

methods.name: quickUsersResolutionSmoke()
methods.description: Performs a quick test of the URL resolution for a specific organization ID ('T0015') to verify correct URL construction during development.
